Checklists.title: Checklists
Checklists.body:
A checklist walks you through a recurring job step by step: the VAT period up to the filed and paid return, the month close up to the lock, the year close up to the sealed year.

Checks the system knows fulfil themselves. A posting shows you a preview first and you trigger it yourself; plausibility checks show you the formula and the figures.

Every posting before the close can be reversed, the close cannot. The month and the VAT period start by themselves; the year you start deliberately.

denied.read: You lack the read_books right, so no checklist is shown here.

error.transport: The checklists could not be loaded.

empty.title: No checklist yet
empty.hint: Start the VAT period or the month close for the last period that has ended, or the year close for {year}. The steps and deadlines come by themselves.

missing.title: This checklist does not exist
missing.hint: The link points at no checklist in this workspace.

detail.done: Every step is done, not applicable or dropped.
detail.autostarted: Started automatically by the rule "{rule} start automatically" on {date}.

note.excludedBy: Dropped because of the answer at "{item}".
note.stale: The return changed since the sign-off. Recompute it and sign off again.
note.staleStatements: The figures changed since the sign-off. Review the balance sheet and income statement and sign off again.
note.preconditionOpen: The check {check} has to pass first.

check.no_drafts: No drafts up to the period end

item.no_drafts: No drafts up to the period end
item.bank_balance_matches: Bank statement at the period end matches
item.bank_balance_typed: Bank balance at the year end per statement
item.accruals_reversed_next_year: Reversal in the new year present
item.vat_accounts_zero: VAT accounts at zero at the year end
item.vat_declared_equals_books: VAT returns agree with the accounts
item.statements_signed: Balance sheet and income statement released
item.gv_approved: General meeting approved the annual accounts

choice.derived: Answered by the system from the books. You can change the answer.

preview.refused: The preview could not be computed: {code}
preview.changeAnswer: If that is wrong, change the answer above.

posting.nothingToSettle: Nothing to settle: the VAT accounts of this period are at zero.

validationReason.first_year: first fiscal year, no prior year
validationReason.no_statement_no_typed_balance: no bank statement at the period end and no entered balance
validationReason.unfiled_periods: not every VAT period is filed yet

validationSource.statement: Compared with the bank statement at the period end.
validationSource.typed: Compared with the balance you entered.
validationSource.none: No bank statement at the period end. Import the statement or enter the balance in the step "Bank balance at the year end per statement".

statements.loading: Loading the balance sheet and income statement

confirm.fx: Revalues the foreign-currency positions as of {date} and posts the difference with its automatic reversal.
confirm.undo: Posts a reversing entry. The original entry stays on record.
confirm.undoCount: Posts {count} reversing entries. The original entries stay on record.
confirm.batch: Posts {count} drafts totalling {total}, one after another.
confirm.taxProvision: Records the tax provision of {total} and posts it.
confirm.settle: Transfers the VAT accounts of period {period} to account 2201.
confirm.settleAll: Transfers the VAT accounts of periods {periods} to account 2201, one after another.
confirm.softLock: Locks the fiscal year {period} provisionally. The lock can be lifted again.
confirm.seal: Closes the fiscal year {year} for good.

start.title: Start a checklist

consequence.vat_period: Creates the checklist with every step and deadline. A checklist is abandoned, never deleted.
consequence.month_close: Creates the month close with every step. A month otherwise starts by itself once it has ended.
consequence.year_close: Creates the year close with every step and deadline. The last month of the year is then no longer started on its own.

start.needsConfig: Without VAT settings there are no filing periods.
start.notFilable: That is not a filing period of this year. Possible: {periods}
start.notEnded: This period has not ended yet.
start.yearClosed: This fiscal year is already closed.
start.yearInProgress: The last month of the year belongs to the running year close.

attest.title: Filed in the ESTV ePortal
attest.consequence: Marks the step as filed. The period is not locked by this.
attest.beforeExport: The date lies before the export on {exportedAt}.
attest.alreadyAttested: The filing is already attested on {date}. Reopen the step first.

gv.title: General meeting approved the annual accounts
gv.reason: Reason the meeting took place before the release
gv.consequence: Records the date of the approval. The meeting itself takes place outside TILL.
gv.needsDate: Give the date of the meeting.
gv.needsReason: The meeting lies before the release of the annual accounts. Give a reason.
gv.alreadyAttested: The approval is already attested. Reopen the step first.

skip.title: {item}: not applicable
skip.consequence: The step counts as not applicable and stays visible.

prefill.bank_balance_typed: A bank statement is on file.

acknowledge.title: {item}: acknowledge
acknowledge.consequence: The check stays visible and falls due again when the figures change.

release.title: Release the balance sheet and income statement {period}
release.consequence: Releases the balance sheet and income statement as they stand. If a posting changes the figures, the release becomes void.

signoff.title: {item}
signoff.needsReference: Name the reference that proves the payment.
signoff.consequenceReview: Confirms the bridge for the return as computed now. If the return changes, the sign-off becomes void.
signoff.consequencePayment: Confirms that the payment or credit is booked. The reference stays on the step.
signoff.consequenceBalance: Records the balance per bank statement. The check "bank statement matches" compares it with the books.

abandon.title: Abandon checklist {period}
abandon.consequence: The checklist stays visible and feeds no attention items any more. It is not deleted.

templateHint.vat_period: From the open books to the filed, locked and paid return.
templateHint.month_close: Checks, foreign currencies, accruals and the soft lock of the month.
templateHint.year_close: From the open year to the sealed fiscal year, with a preview before every posting.

formula.locks_on_all_months: Every month of the period except the last carries a lock.
formula.open_items_debtors: Sum of open customer invoices as of the date = balance of account 1100.
formula.bank_balance_matches: Balance per bank statement at the period end = balance of the bank account in the books.
formula.open_items_creditors: Sum of open vendor bills less on-account payments as of the date = balance of account 2000.
formula.accruals_reversed: Account 1300 and account 2300 are at zero on the first day after the period end.
formula.depreciation_within_limit: Per asset: posted depreciation at most rate times book value (declining) or cost over useful life (straight line), pro rata to the months.
formula.vat_accounts_zero: Accounts 1170, 1171 and 2200 are at zero at the period end; account 2201 carries the last settlement.
formula.vat_declared_equals_books: Sum of Ziffer 399 = credits on account 2200; sum of Ziffer 400 and 405 = debits on accounts 1170 and 1171.
formula.umsatzabstimmung: Revenue per income statement minus accruals plus asset disposals = sum of Ziffer 200 of the returns.
formula.tax_provision_plausible: Posted tax provision within five percent of the provision per formula (profit times rate over one plus rate, less instalments paid).
formula.balance_equation: Sum of assets = sum of liabilities and equity as of the date; sum of debits = sum of credits over the period.
formula.prior_year_comparison: Per income account: a note when the change against the prior year exceeds fifty percent AND five thousand francs.
formula.capital_loss: Equity at least half of capital and statutory reserves.

legalForm.einzelfirma: No tax provision, no general meeting.
legalForm.gmbh: Tax provision, capital-loss check and members' meeting are added.
legalForm.ag: Tax provision, capital-loss check and general meeting are added.

vatMethod.effektiv: Settling the VAT accounts, turnover and input tax reconciliation are added.
vatMethod.saldo: Settling the VAT accounts and the turnover reconciliation are added.
vatMethod.none: The whole VAT block is dropped.
